commands.help:
Usage: avalanche research tree [OPTIONS] [wiki|repo|both]

  Print tracked wiki pages, repository structure, or both (the default).

  Titles are simple frontmatter scalars. Nodes describe files, not delivery status.
  Missing files and symlinks are excluded. No data contents or network are read.

Options:
  --root DIRECTORY       Avalanche repository root. Default: discover from cwd, then
                         package checkout.
  --depth INTEGER RANGE  Edges below the root (0: root only). Defaults: wiki 4, repo 2;
                         explicit depth shows nested files.  [0<=x<=20]
  --include-untracked    Also inventory nonignored untracked files, excluding data,
                         runtime and private cache directories.
  --json                 Emit the same bounded tree as JSON with checkout provenance.
  --help                 Show this message and exit.

symbols.summary: Whether one value is exactly a whole number: an integer, or a finite float or Decimal with no fraction. A boolean, text or a missing value is not.

modules.summary: Scoring a forecast from an origin against the validation protocol's naive benchmarks.

symbols.name: actual_at
symbols.summary: The realized value ``horizon_days`` after the origin.

symbols.name: persistence
symbols.summary: ``N1``: the value at the origin.

symbols.name: drift
symbols.summary: ``N2``: the origin value plus ``horizon_days`` times the mean daily change over ``window_days`` before it.

symbols.name: reduced_form
symbols.summary: ``N3``: an AR(1) on weekly changes, fitted by least squares on weeks ending at the origin, then iterated.

symbols.name: benchmarks
symbols.summary: Each benchmark's forecast at each horizon, one row per benchmark and horizon.

symbols.name: mase_scale
symbols.summary: The mean absolute one-day change up to the origin, the denominator of the scaled error.

symbols.name: scaled_error
symbols.summary: The absolute error in units of the mean one-day change before the origin.

symbols.name: diebold_mariano
symbols.summary: Whether forecast A has lower expected loss than forecast B.

symbols.name: crps_ensemble
symbols.summary: ``E|X - y| - E|X - X'| / 2`` for the sample, by the sorted-sample identity.

symbols.name: crps_normal
symbols.summary: The CRPS of a normal forecast: ``sd * (z * (2 Phi(z) - 1) + 2 phi(z) - 1 / sqrt(pi))``.

symbols.name: pit
symbols.summary: The forecast's probability below the realized value, counting half of any probability exactly on it.

symbols.name: central_interval
symbols.summary: The central interval holding ``level`` of the forecast, by the linear quantile rule.

symbols.name: interval_score
symbols.summary: The width plus ``2 / alpha`` times any miss, ``alpha = 1 - level`` (Gneiting and Raftery, 2007).

symbols.name: dressed
symbols.summary: ``N1d`` or ``N2d``: a benchmark spread by every ``horizon_days`` change that ends by the origin.

symbols.name: _local_level_filter
symbols.summary: Log-likelihood, filtered level and its variance, conditioning on the first value.

symbols.name: fit_local_level
symbols.summary: Maximum-likelihood fit of ``y[t] = mu[t] + eps``, ``mu[t+1] = mu[t] + eta``.

symbols.name: local_level
symbols.summary: ``N4``: the mean and standard deviation of the local-level forecast fitted on every day to the origin.

symbols.name: distribution_scores
symbols.summary: CRPS, PIT, 50% and 80% coverage, the 80% interval score and width, with CRPS, score and width over ``scale``.

symbols.name: dm_horizon
symbols.summary: The Diebold-Mariano horizon: one plus the most later origins that fall inside one forecast's window.

symbols.name: chronological
symbols.summary: ``origins`` sorted by their dates in ``dates``, a mapping or Series from origin to date, for lagged tests.

symbols.name: _real
symbols.summary: A column of real numbers as floats. Other types, and integers too large to hold exactly as floats, are refused, since converting them would lose information.

symbols.name: _flag
symbols.summary: A test result as True, False or None. NumPy booleans count as booleans, and any other value is refused.

symbols.name: _utc_days

symbols.name: adoption_verdict
